**Yes.** Treatment is randomized only *within* each hospital, because the two hospitals use different assignment rates (90% and 10%). Hospital therefore affects who gets the drug, and it may also affect days hospitalized directly, through things like quality of care. Controlling for severity blocks only the path that runs through severity. It does not block any direct link from hospital to days, so hospital should be in the model as well.

I reasoned this from the study design and did not run anything on the CSV.

ANSWER: yes
